name: Listing Title Presence and Length
description: Verifies that the 'title' field exists, is a non-empty string, and does not exceed 100 characters.

name: Price Format and Validity
description: Ensures the 'price' field is a positive number (integer or float) and formatted correctly (e.g., no negative values, no non-numeric characters).

name: Image URL Validity and Count
description: Confirms that the 'images' array contains at least one valid HTTP/HTTPS URL and that all URLs are reachable (status code 200) or follow a valid URL pattern.

name: Category and Condition Consistency
description: Validates that the 'category' field matches a predefined list of allowed categories and that the 'condition' field is one of the accepted enum values (e.g., 'new', 'used', 'refurbished').

name: Description Minimum Length and Keyword Density
description: Checks that the 'description' field is at least 50 characters long and contains at least 3 distinct keywords from a predefined product-specific keyword list.
